## 自测清单 / Self-Check
<!-- 提交前请确认 / Confirm before submitting -->
- [ ] 服务器可正常启动（`./start.sh`）/ Server starts normally (`./start.sh`)
- [ ] 已在 PHP 7.3 / 7.4 上测试 / Tested on PHP 7.3 / 7.4
- [ ] 不影响现有插件兼容性 / No impact on existing plugin compatibility
- [ ] 相关日志无新增报错 / No new errors in relevant logs
- [ ] 如涉及配置，已提供向后兼容 / Config changes are backward compatible (if applicable)
